subject: general
question:
The given pie chart shows the number of students in six different Houses- P, Q, R, S, T and U of VV International School. Study the chart and answer the question. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecccf1214fbd948788d3711722c81a7ebd1c72c2f7b3403bab9602c3d52a099d.png] 

Find the ratio of students in House S to students in House T.
solution:
**Given:**

__
 
• Total no. of students=2400
 
• Percentage of students from houses P, Q, R, S, T, and U are 24%, 21%, 16%, 12%, 18%, and 9% respectively.

**Concept used:**

 
• No. of students = Total no. of students × percentage

**Calculations:**

We know that,

 
• No. of students in house S = Total no. of students × percentage = 2400 × 12%= (2400 × 12)/100= 288
 
• No. of students in house T = Total no. of students × percentage = 2400 × 18%= (2400 × 18)/100= 432

Now,

The ratio of students in House S to students in House T = No. of students in house S: No. of students in house T = 288 : 432 = 2:3

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **Shortcut Trick__**Percentage of students in house S = 12%

Percentage of students in house T = 18%

Ratio = 12 : 18

2 : 3
